purpose: Semantic convergence queue. Open items are behaviors/oracles still needing clean ownership, proof or explicit rejection; accounted findings preserve negative/translated knowledge so future agents do not repeat branch archaeology.

items.question: Do all rendering/read/copy/blit operations fail closed with GL_INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION before native lowering when the relevant FBO is incomplete, including zero-work calls?
items.exit_condition: port/rebase the current semantic delta onto current integration, add/retain a focused negative oracle, and close with latest-head shared/backend proof

items.question: Does the clean host/presentation implementation already contain every unique iOS/Amethyst runtime-isolation invariant from this source ref?
items.exit_condition: compare unique source/test delta against current clean host contract and either transplant missing invariants or record exact containment

items.question: Should VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32 be represented as depth-only rather than depth/stencil in the relevant Vulkan format/aspect path?
items.exit_condition: build a focused aspect/readback oracle, compare clean Vulkan behavior, then transplant or reject the legacy rule with evidence

items.question: Is the current 32-bit normalized integer vertex path semantically correct via shader-side conversion, or must unsupported combinations fail closed?
items.exit_condition: add a focused value-level oracle covering normalization and both backends, then preserve the proven policy

items.question: Should the clean GL contract advertise GL_EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic and expose GL_MAX_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT with a non-truncated floating capability derived from each native backend?
items.exit_condition: establish the Minecraft/Sodium/Iris observable requirement, add a float/int capability oracle, then implement per-backend capability lowering or explicitly reject the extension contract

items.question: Can clean Vulkan execute one GL-visible user uniform block referenced by both VS and FS, with glUniformBlockBinding updates reaching both stage-internal bindings and correct value-level rendering?
items.exit_condition: extend/split the clean UBO oracle so the same logical block is consumed by both stages on Vulkan, implement only the missing Vulkan/lowering seam, and preserve clean per-stage internal binding identity

items.question: Which complete GL_PACK/UNPACK row/image/skip, PBO offset/shadow and BGRA/RGBA readback semantics proven in the legacy GUI lineage are still missing from the clean shared/Vulkan path?
items.exit_condition: enumerate semantic delta against clean tree, port only missing shared/Vulkan behavior with focused transfer/readback oracles, then mark source refs provenance-only

items.question: Which user-FBO/default-framebuffer winding, viewport orientation, Y-flip, BGRA and GUI/text presentation invariants from the legacy iOS path must exist at the clean Vulkan presentation seam?
items.exit_condition: transplant small orientation/culling/presentation oracles first, then port only behavior they prove and close with exact-subject Minecraft/host evidence

items.question: Which descriptor-pool, resource reuse, persistent-map and GPU-busy lifetime findings from the legacy lineage are real native-lifetime requirements rather than discarded hypotheses?
items.exit_condition: map each experiment outcome to a stable lifetime/ownership invariant or explicit rejection, then leave only reusable oracles/code in the clean Vulkan seam

items.question: Which vertex/index/UV/interface and single-MoltenVK shader findings are still unique to legacy DirectVulkan and should be expressed in shared shader/lowering contracts?
items.exit_condition: compare clean shader/draw oracles to the legacy failures, transplant only missing semantics, and record rejected hypotheses

items.question: What minimum reusable real-Minecraft DirectVulkan oracle and diagnostics should live in the clean evidence plane without carrying one-off candidate workflows?
items.exit_condition: extract a stable exact-subject E2E oracle/diagnostic contract into clean CI or scripts, then retire branch-local trigger machinery as provenance

accounted_findings.finding: The legacy patch forced same-named VS/FS UBOs to one Vulkan descriptor number. Clean reflection already models one GL-visible block while retaining separate vertex_internal_binding and fragment_internal_binding. Preserve logical block identity and prove both stages; do not transplant shared descriptor-number identity as a generic invariant.

The legacy Apple glX-style resolver used dladdr/dlopen(self) to avoid RTLD_DEFAULT resolving same-named system OpenGLES symbols. The current clean host contract uses directly exported GL symbols and does not make this resolver path an acceptance requirement. Do not transplant it unless a real clean host lookup requirement/oracle demonstrates the need.

The 899-line mc_gui_smoke combines culling/orientation, PBO upload bounds, anisotropy query, cross-stage UBO value flow and descriptor/fence stress. Treat it as provenance for several small clean oracles; do not make the composite legacy harness the clean architectural boundary.
